fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional summary of what this flow does.
fields.captureModeJudgeOnly: Capture Mode only applies when the Guard Rail Method is LLM as judge — the other methods have no judge to invert.
fields.abandonHandoffMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Before you go — would you like to talk to one of our consultants?
fields.abandonHandoffMessageHint: When the judge detects the visitor wants to quit, end with this offer to talk to a human (and flag the conversation for handoff) instead of just saying goodbye. Leave blank to keep the default close.
fields.abandonHandoffMessageJudgeOnly: Abandonment Handoff only applies when the Guard Rail Method is LLM as judge — the other methods have no abandonment signal.
fields.triggerDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Use this flow when the user wants to schedule a meeting or asks about appointment availability.
fields.triggerDescriptionHint: Natural-language hint the LLM router uses to decide whether a user message should activate this flow. Leave blank to disable auto-trigger.
fields.helpWriteTriggerTitle: Help me write the trigger description
fields.helpWriteTriggerDescription: Describe in your own words when this flow should kick in — example intents, user phrasings, when it should NOT fire. The LLM will rewrite a concise trigger description the router can use.
fields.helpWriteTriggerPlaceholder: e.g. Activate when the user wants to order pizza, mentions toppings, sizes, delivery or pickup. Do NOT trigger on general menu questions or complaints.
fields.helpWriteTriggerHint: Tip: also describe what should NOT trigger this flow, not only what should.
fields.autoPromoteHint: When enabled, a daily job checks statistical significance and, once a winner is declared, pins it to 100% of traffic and archives the losing variants. Leave off to keep manual control — you can still promote on demand from the significance report.
fields.banditEnabledHint: When enabled, the engine ignores traffic weight and adapts to observed conversion using Thompson sampling on the goal-achieved rate. Activate on at least one variant under the same experiment key to enable bandit mode.
fields.experimentKeyHint: Identifier shared across all variants of one A/B test (e.g. 'pricing-page-tone'). Stable: changing it ends the experiment and starts a new one.
fields.preserveAllSlotsHint: Bring every slot captured in earlier flows on this conversation through to this flow. Writes the wildcard mapping {\"*\":\"*\"}. Toggle off to author a specific slot map below.
fields.slotInheritanceJsonHint: JSON object {"receivingSlot":"sourceSlot"}. Use the same name on both sides for a straight pass-through; use different names to rename, e.g. {"position":"cargo_atual"}. Slots not in the map are NOT inherited.
fields.successMetricHint: Which conversion the bandit optimises for and the significance test scores. Goal achieved is the default; the others activate once the analytics store persists those signals.
fields.trafficWeightHint: Relative weight (0-100) across variants. (50, 50) splits evenly; (90, 10) routes 90% to the first. Sums do not have to equal 100 — only ratios matter. 0 pauses this arm without deleting it.
fields.variantLabelHint: This flow's arm inside the experiment ('control', 'treatment_v2', 'warmer_tone'). Surfaces as the grouping dimension in the analytics dashboard.

ONCE.label: Once per conversation
ONCE.description: After this flow ends, the router will not re-trigger it in the same conversation.

ALWAYS.label: Always re-trigger
ALWAYS.description: Whenever the user message matches the trigger description, the flow restarts from its first step.

AUTO.label: Auto-detect
AUTO.description: Router detects the trigger language per route. Good default — only override if you notice EN flows under-matching.

PT.label: Portuguese
PT.description: Tokenize with the Portuguese analyzer (light stemming, PT stopwords). Pick when the trigger is written in Portuguese.

EN.label: English
EN.description: Tokenize with the English analyzer (Porter stemming, EN stopwords). Pick when the trigger is written in English.

LLM_JUDGE.label: LLM as judge (recommended)
LLM_JUDGE.description: Most reliable in production. After each turn, a focused LLM call returns a JSON verdict (on-topic, collected value, ready to advance). The judge runs without chat history or tool noise, so even smaller models follow the contract reliably. ~1 extra LLM call per turn (~200 extra tokens).

HEURISTIC.label: Heuristic (cheapest)
HEURISTIC.description: Prompt-only contract + regex/keyword heuristics. No extra LLM calls. Reliable for nodes with strict validation rules (email, phone, number, date, URL). For free-text nodes (name, flavor, generic question) it accepts any user reply as the value — fragile in real conversations.

STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.label: Structured output (single call)
STRUCTURED_OUTPUT.description: Tries to bundle the user-facing reply and the verdict in one JSON call. Sounds ideal, but smaller models (GPT-4o-mini) often ignore the JSON contract when chat history grows or many tools are active, and fall back to a judge call anyway — costing more than LLM as judge alone. Worth picking only with top-tier models (GPT-4o full, Claude 3.7 Sonnet).

VALIDATE_THEN_CAPTURE.label: Validate then capture (default)
VALIDATE_THEN_CAPTURE.description: Legacy behaviour. The judge runs first and gates the capture — the slot is written only when the judge accepts the value. A rejected reply leaves the slot empty and keeps the cursor on the step (the classic 'flow stuck on a null slot'). Use onJudgeReject on a step to soften this per-node.

CAPTURE_THEN_GATE.label: Capture first, validation gates
CAPTURE_THEN_GATE.description: The user reply is written to the slot before the judge runs, so the slot is never empty after an answer. The judge becomes advisory — it refines the value and writes a <slot>__confidence grade but can no longer block a value that passes the step's validation rule. A failing validation rule (email, phone, CPF…) still re-prompts, now with the attempt captured and confidence=low.

CAPTURE_THEN_GRADE.label: Capture first, always advance
CAPTURE_THEN_GRADE.description: Capture-then-grade: the reply is written to the slot and the flow always advances unless the user abandons. Both the validation rule and the judge are purely advisory — they only set the <slot>__confidence grade. Maximum 'never stall', but a downstream step must decide what to do with low-confidence captures.

properties.empty: Select a node to edit its properties.
properties.aiInstructionPlaceholder: Ask the user a question and capture the answer. Expected Output: the value you want to store.
properties.aiInstructionHint: Prompt forwarded to Spring AI when this step runs.
properties.outputVariableEmpty: No slots defined for this agent. Add one under Slots in the sidebar first.
properties.outputVariableHint: Picks from the agent's typed-slot catalogue so the captured value lands in a stable schema.
properties.overrideExistingValueHint: When unchecked, the engine skips this step if the slot is already filled. Check to always ask and overwrite the previous value.
properties.onJudgeReject: When the judge rejects the answer
properties.onJudgeRejectHint: Only applies when the agent's guardrailMethod is LLM_JUDGE. Default reprompts the user when the judge produced a substantive redirect; advance_with_literal force-captures the user message after retry; block always trusts the judge.

onJudgeRejectOptions.advance_with_literal: Advance with literal — force-capture user message

properties.toolsEnabled: Allow tool calls on this node
properties.toolsEnabledHint: When off, the agent's tool callbacks (MCP / native / custom) are stripped on this node. Use to gate the LLM from preemptively calling a tool before a slot is captured. Replaces the legacy "NÃO CHAME NENHUMA TOOL" sentinel in aiInstruction.
properties.requiredToolsHint: Tool names that must reach the LLM on this node, even when the tool-prefilter would otherwise drop them due to low similarity with the user message. Use one name per line — must match the @Tool name, MCP tool name, or custom-tool name.

nodeAbTest.experimentKeyHint: Set a key to A/B this single node's instruction. Each conversation is stickily assigned one arm below — no need to duplicate the whole flow. Independent from the flow-level A/B on the Settings tab.
nodeAbTest.empty: No variants yet. Add at least two arms to run the test.
nodeAbTest.instructionPlaceholder: Instruction / template override — leave blank for the control arm (keeps the base text).
nodeAbTest.variantsHint: Weights are relative (50/50 ≡ 1/1). An arm with weight 0 is paused. A blank override keeps the node's authored text — use it for the control arm. On functionCall / scheduleAgent nodes the override swaps the tool input / routine payload template instead of a question.

properties.nativeToolHint: Spring AI @Tool method exposed by the Turing backend.
properties.mcpServerHint: All tools exposed by the selected MCP server will be available to the LLM.

scheduleAgent.routineIdEmpty: No routines defined. Create one under Routines first.
scheduleAgent.routineIdHint: Configured routine to run asynchronously. The flow pauses on this node until the routine writes the output slot (or the timeout expires).
scheduleAgent.payloadTemplateHint: JSON template passed to the routine. {{slotName}} placeholders are interpolated from the conversation's slot map before dispatch. Leave blank to send {}.
scheduleAgent.timeoutMsHint: Per-node override (milliseconds). Leave blank to use the routine's default. On expiry the engine takes the 'timeout' outgoing edge (or the first edge if none is wired).

webhook.webhookEmpty: No webhooks defined. Create one under Webhooks first.
webhook.webhookHint: Fires the selected webhook (CRM push) when the flow reaches this node. The target URL, method, headers, payload template and credentials come from the webhook's own configuration.

humanApproval.targetPlaceholder: Where to send the approval request
humanApproval.templatePlaceholder: Lead {{name}} from {{company}} is ready to convert. Please review.
humanApproval.templateHint: Message sent to the approver. {{slotName}} placeholders are filled from the conversation's slots. The resume link is appended automatically.
humanApproval.approvalSlotHint: Slot the operator's decision (approve | reject | edit:<text>) is written into. Wire a condition/switch downstream to branch on it. Defaults to operator_decision.
humanApproval.timeoutHint: Auto-resolve after this many seconds with no decision. 0 or blank waits indefinitely.

properties.continueOnFailureHint: When checked, a tool/routine failure routes the flow along the outgoing edge whose handle is 'failure' — wire an alternative path for graceful recovery (apologize, ask user to re-input, escalate to handoff). When unchecked, the engine logs the error and advances to the first outgoing edge (legacy behavior).
properties.subFlowEmpty: No other chat flows are available for this agent.
properties.subFlowHint: When this step runs, control is handed off to the selected chat flow within the same AI agent.
properties.personaPlaceholder: Pick a persona from the agent's catalog
properties.personaEmpty: This agent has no personas in its catalog. Add some on the agent's Personas page.
properties.personaHint: When this step runs, the conversation immediately switches to this persona's voice. The change persists until another Persona node is reached or the conversation ends.
properties.switchVariableEmpty: No slots defined for this agent. Add one under Slots in the sidebar first.
properties.switchVariableHint: Picks the typed slot the engine reads to route this Switch — keep one slot per branching variable.
properties.switchOverrideHint: When checked, the Switch re-evaluates the slot even if it already had a value; otherwise it reuses the previously captured value as-is.
properties.switchOptionsHint: Each option becomes a separate handle on the right of the node — wire it to a different downstream flow.
properties.subFlowSwitchOptionsHint: Each option binds a label-match to a sub-flow descent. The wildcard outgoing edge fires when no option matches or the matched option has no sub-flow selected.
properties.subFlowSwitchOptionPlaceholder: Pick a sub-flow for this option…
properties.switchOptionsEmpty: No options yet — add one to expose a branch.
properties.slotOperationHint: Set writes a literal value to the chosen slot; Delete removes the slot from the conversation state.
properties.slotNameEmpty: No slots defined for this agent. Add one under Slots in the sidebar first.
properties.slotNameHint: Slot the engine writes to (or deletes). Must be declared on the agent's slot catalogue.
properties.slotValueHint: Stored verbatim in the conversation state; downstream Switch or AI Question nodes can read it.
properties.slotOverrideHint: When checked, overwrite the slot even if it already had a value; otherwise the node no-ops to preserve the existing value.
properties.completionModeHint: After the body sub-flow finishes an item: mark it done (keeps an auditable plan) or remove it (queue-drain). Both terminate the loop.
properties.convertToFormDescription: These {{count}} consecutive questions become one multi-field form. The collapse stops because {{reason}}.
properties.formFieldsEmpty: No fields yet — this formCapture behaves as a single-field capture. Add fields to render a native multi-field form.
properties.inlineOptionsHint: Rendered as clickable chips under the assistant message. Clicking sends the label as the user reply — does not branch the flow.
properties.iteratePlanBodyHint: Runs once per pending item. The current item is exposed to the sub-flow as {{__planItemTitle}} / {{__planItemId}}.
properties.iteratePlanSlotHint: Slot to read the plan from — must match the Planning Step that produced it (default __plan).
properties.planRegenerateHint: When off (default), a plan already present in the slot is kept across re-entries. When on, the step regenerates the plan every time it runs.
properties.planSchemaHint: Free-form hint steering the JSON item shape. The backend normalizes the model's output to {id, title, status} regardless — leave blank for the default.
properties.planSlotHint: Conversation slot that receives the JSON plan (default __plan). Point a downstream Iterate Plan node at the same slot.
properties.planningGoalHint: The LLM decomposes this goal into a typed TODO list (id, title, status) written into the plan slot below.
properties.planningGoalPlaceholder: Break the user's goal into 3-6 concrete, ordered steps.
properties.writeSlotValueHint: Supports {{slotName}} template references — resolved at write time using the conversation's current variable map. Unknown slots resolve to the empty string.

preview.footer: Preview walks the flow following the first outgoing edge of each node. It does not execute tools or LLMs.

aiChat.placeholder: e.g. Build a flow for booking a hotel: ask the user for the destination city, check-in/out dates, and number of guests, validate each value, then call a function to look up availability and end with a confirmation summary.
aiChat.empty: Start by describing the conversation you want to script. I'll add nodes, connect branches, and pick guard rails as we chat.
aiChat.tipTitle: Tell me what your bot should do
aiChat.tipDesc: Describe the goal, the questions to ask, what to validate, and any external lookups. I'll build a flow with start/end, AI questions, conditions, and function calls.
aiChat.metaDesc: Routing and runtime configuration for this flow.
aiChat.graphDesc: Ordered preview of nodes and their branches. The visual editor opens after Save.
aiChat.nameRequired: Please give the chat flow a name before saving.
aiChat.emptyFlow: Add at least one step before saving.

funnel.title: Funnel — drop-off & completion
funnel.reachedContinued: reached this node → continued past it

lint.description: {{count}} issue(s) detected on this flow. Fix the ERROR ones before saving — the runtime will stall on them.
lint.title: Authoring warnings

ai_instruction_too_long.hint: Tighten the instruction or split the node — verbose addenda inflate token cost and dilute the model's attention.

unused_output_variable.message: Slot '{{slot}}' is captured here but never read downstream
unused_output_variable.hint: Either consume it (use {{slotRef}} in another node, drive a switch on it, or declare it as an inheritance source on another flow) or remove the outputVariable.

dead_end_node.message: Node has no outgoing edge — the conversation stalls when it reaches here
dead_end_node.hint: Wire an edge to the next node, or change the type to 'end' if this is a legitimate terminal.

edge_without_label.message: Edge from {{type}} node has no sourceHandle and no label
edge_without_label.hint: Pick which branch this edge represents ('yes'/'no' for condition, an option id for switch) — the runtime cannot disambiguate without one.

form_field_blank_name.message: A form field has no slot name — its value cannot be captured
form_field_blank_name.hint: Pick a declared slot for every field on the form.

form_field_duplicate_name.message: Two form fields write the same slot '{{slot}}' — the later value wins
form_field_duplicate_name.hint: Give each field its own slot, or remove the duplicate field.

form_field_unknown_slot.message: Form field writes slot '{{slot}}' which is not declared on the agent
form_field_unknown_slot.hint: Declare the slot in the agent's slot catalog so the value lands in the typed schema and is readable downstream.

planning_step_unused_plan.message: Plan slot '{{slot}}' is generated here but never iterated or read downstream
planning_step_unused_plan.hint: Add an iteratePlan node reading this slot, or render it with {{slotRef}} — otherwise the planning LLM call is wasted.

iterate_plan_no_body.message: iteratePlan has no body sub-flow — it will mark every plan item done without executing anything
iterate_plan_no_body.hint: Set the node's sub-flow (subFlowId) to the flow that should run once per plan item.

trigger_conflict.message: Trigger description overlaps with flow '{{other}}' ({{pct}}% Jaccard)

triggerConflicts.description: The procedural router cannot reliably separate these flows on overlapping user messages — it falls back to the LLM router each time. Add distinguishing vocabulary or a negative-list clause to one side.
triggerConflicts.title: Trigger description ambiguity
triggerConflicts.emptyDescription: The procedural router can separate this agent's chat flows on their trigger descriptions. New overlaps will surface here.

variant.description: Describe the tone, length, or audience change you want. The LLM rewrites only the user-facing copy — node ids, edges, slots, and tool calls stay the same.
variant.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. 'more casual tone, 30% shorter, target Gen Z' or 'translate to Portuguese'
variant.savedDisabledHint: Saved variants land disabled so you can review the rewrite in the editor before enabling.
variant.title: Generate variant of '{{name}}'
